title: Causative (have/get done)
note: have/get something done · first draft night/2026-08-06

items.en: I had my car repaired yesterday.
items.gap: I ____ my car repaired yesterday.
accepts: I had my car repaired yesterday.
items.explanation: have + object + past participle: someone else did the work.
items.explanation_cz: have + předmět + past participle: práci udělal někdo jiný.

items.en: She is getting her hair cut tomorrow.
items.gap: She is ____ her hair cut tomorrow.
accepts: She is getting her hair cut tomorrow.
items.explanation: get + object + past participle (often more informal than have).
items.explanation_cz: get + předmět + past participle (častěji neformální).

items.en: We need to have the roof fixed.
items.gap: We need to ____ the roof fixed.
accepts: We need to have the roof fixed.
We need to get the roof fixed.
items.explanation: need to have something done: arrange for service.
items.explanation_cz: need to have something done: zajistit službu.

items.en: He got his phone unlocked.
items.gap: He ____ his phone unlocked.
accepts: He got his phone unlocked.
items.explanation: got + object + past participle: past informal causative.
items.explanation_cz: got + předmět + past participle: minulý neformální causative.

items.en: They had the documents translated.
items.gap: They ____ the documents translated.
accepts: They had the documents translated.
items.explanation: have + object + past participle for professional service.
items.explanation_cz: have + předmět + past participle pro profesionální službu.

items.en: I am having a new kitchen installed.
items.gap: I am ____ a new kitchen installed.
accepts: I am having a new kitchen installed.
items.explanation: continuous causative: arrangement in progress.
items.explanation_cz: průběhový causative: probíhající domluva/práce.

items.en: Did you have your eyes tested?
items.gap: Did you ____ your eyes tested?
accepts: Did you have your eyes tested?
items.explanation: Question: did + have + object + past participle.
items.explanation_cz: Otázka: did + have + předmět + past participle.

items.en: She gets her car washed every week.
items.cz: Každý týden si nechá umýt auto.
items.gap: She ____ her car washed every week.
accepts: She gets her car washed every week.
items.explanation: Habit: get + object + past participle.
items.explanation_cz: Zvyk: get + předmět + past participle.

items.en: We had the house painted last year.
items.gap: We ____ the house painted last year.
accepts: We had the house painted last year.
items.explanation: Past service arranged: had + object + past participle.
items.explanation_cz: Minulá domluvená služba: had + předmět + past participle.

items.en: You should get that tooth checked.
items.cz: Měl bys si nechat zkontrolovat ten zub.
items.gap: You should ____ that tooth checked.
accepts: You should get that tooth checked.
You should have that tooth checked.
items.explanation: Advice: should get/have something done.
items.explanation_cz: Rada: should get/have something done.

items.en: I am going to have my laptop repaired.
items.gap: I am going to ____ my laptop repaired.
accepts: I am going to have my laptop repaired.
I am going to get my laptop repaired.
items.explanation: Future plan: going to have something done.
items.explanation_cz: Plán: going to have something done.

items.en: They got the contracts signed this morning.
items.gap: They ____ the contracts signed this morning.
accepts: They got the contracts signed this morning.
They had the contracts signed this morning.
items.explanation: got + object + past participle for completed arrangement.
items.explanation_cz: got + předmět + past participle pro dokončenou domluvu.

items.en: Where can I have this package delivered?
items.cz: Kde si můžu nechat doručit ten balíček?
items.gap: Where can I ____ this package delivered?
accepts: Where can I have this package delivered?
Where can I get this package delivered?
items.explanation: can + have + object + past participle: arrange delivery.
items.explanation_cz: can + have + předmět + past participle: zajistit doručení.

items.en: She had her wedding dress made in Italy.
items.cz: Svatební šaty si nechala ušít v Itálii.
items.gap: She had her wedding dress ____ in Italy.
accepts: She had her wedding dress made in Italy.
items.explanation: Object + past participle (made), not bare make.
items.explanation_cz: Předmět + past participle (made), ne holé make.

items.en: We are having the office cleaned every Friday.
items.cz: Každý pátek si necháváme uklidit kancelář.
items.gap: We are ____ the office cleaned every Friday.
accepts: We are having the office cleaned every Friday.
We are getting the office cleaned every Friday.
items.explanation: Regular service: continuous / habitual have something done.
items.explanation_cz: Pravidelná služba: have something done.

items.en: He had his bike stolen last night.
items.cz: Včera v noci mu ukradli kolo.
items.gap: He ____ his bike stolen last night.
accepts: He had his bike stolen last night.
items.explanation: have + object + past participle can mean suffer an unwanted event (theft).
items.explanation_cz: have + předmět + past participle může znamenat utrpět (krádež).

items.en: You ought to get your passport renewed.
items.cz: Měl by sis nechat prodloužit pas.
items.gap: You ought to ____ your passport renewed.
accepts: You ought to get your passport renewed.
You ought to have your passport renewed.
items.explanation: ought to get/have something done: advice about service.
items.explanation_cz: ought to get/have something done: rada ke službě.

items.en: I got my photos printed at the shop.
items.cz: Nechal jsem si fotky vytisknout v obchodě.
items.gap: I got my photos ____ at the shop.
accepts: I got my photos printed at the shop.
items.explanation: After object, use past participle (printed).
items.explanation_cz: Po předmětu past participle (printed).

items.en: They will have the results checked by a specialist.
items.gap: They will ____ the results checked by a specialist.
accepts: They will have the results checked by a specialist.
They will get the results checked by a specialist.
items.explanation: will have + object + past participle: future arrangement.
items.explanation_cz: will have + předmět + past participle: budoucí domluva.

items.en: Have you had the heater fixed yet?
items.gap: Have you ____ the heater fixed yet?
accepts: Have you had the heater fixed yet?
items.explanation: Present perfect question: have you had + object + past participle.
items.explanation_cz: Otázka present perfect: have you had + předmět + past participle.

items.en: She got her nails done before the party.
items.cz: Před večírek si nechala udělat nehty.
items.gap: She ____ her nails done before the party.
accepts: She got her nails done before the party.
She had her nails done before the party.
items.explanation: Informal service: got + object + done.
items.explanation_cz: Neformální služba: got + předmět + done.

items.en: We need to get this report finished by Friday.
items.cz: Musíme tenhle report nechat dodělat do pátku.
items.gap: We need to ____ this report finished by Friday.
accepts: We need to get this report finished by Friday.
We need to have this report finished by Friday.
items.explanation: get something finished: arrange completion (sometimes yourself organising others).
items.explanation_cz: get something finished: zajistit dokončení.

items.en: I had my hair coloured last month.
items.cz: Minulý měsíc jsem si nechal obarvit vlasy.
items.gap: I had my hair ____ last month.
accepts: I had my hair coloured last month.
I had my hair colored last month.
items.explanation: Past participle after object (coloured / colored).
items.explanation_cz: Past participle po předmětu.

items.en: They are getting a new alarm system installed.
items.gap: They are ____ a new alarm system installed.
accepts: They are getting a new alarm system installed.
They are having a new alarm system installed.
items.explanation: Present continuous arrangement: getting/having + object + past participle.
items.explanation_cz: Průběhová domluva: getting/having + předmět + past participle.

items.en: You can have the keys cut at the shop next door.
items.cz: Klíče si můžeš nechat vyrobit v obchodě vedle.
items.gap: You can have the keys ____ at the shop next door.
accepts: You can have the keys cut at the shop next door.
items.explanation: cut is both base and past participle here: object + past participle.
items.explanation_cz: cut = past participle po předmětu.

items.en: He is having his flat redecorated.
items.gap: He is having his flat ____.
accepts: He is having his flat redecorated.
items.explanation: Object + past participle completes the causative pattern.
items.explanation_cz: Předmět + past participle dokončí vzorec.

items.en: We had the piano tuned before the concert.
items.cz: Před koncertem jsme nechali naladit piano.
items.gap: We had the piano ____ before the concert.
accepts: We had the piano tuned before the concert.
items.explanation: Service completed before another event: had + object + past participle.
items.explanation_cz: Služba před jinou událostí: had + předmět + past participle.

items.en: She wants to get her ears pierced.
items.gap: She wants to ____ her ears pierced.
accepts: She wants to get her ears pierced.
She wants to have her ears pierced.
items.explanation: want to get/have something done: desired service.
items.explanation_cz: want to get/have something done: žádaná služba.

items.en: I finally got the printer fixed.
items.cz: Konečně jsem si nechal opravit tiskárnu.
items.gap: I finally ____ the printer fixed.
accepts: I finally got the printer fixed.
I finally had the printer fixed.
items.explanation: got something fixed: informal past success arranging repair.
items.explanation_cz: got something fixed: neformální minulé zajištění opravy.

items.en: Do not have your luggage left unattended.
items.gap: Do not ____ your luggage left unattended.
accepts: Do not have your luggage left unattended.
Don't have your luggage left unattended.
items.explanation: Warning pattern: do not have + object + past participle (state).
items.explanation_cz: Varování: do not have + předmět + past participle.

cards.title: What it is
cards.body: Causative have/get means **you arrange for someone else** to do something (or you experience something done to your things).
points: You do not do the work yourself
Common with services: hair, car, repairs, translations
have is a bit more formal; get is more informal

cards.title: Form (short)
points: Tense on have/get: had, is having, gets, got, will have…
Not: have someone to repair (that is a different pattern)

rows: I am having a kitchen installed.

cards.title: When to use which
points: Professional service / appointment → have or get something done
Informal / spoken → get often sounds natural
Unwanted event (theft, damage) → often have + object + past participle
Active do-it-yourself → normal verb, not causative

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: I repaired my car when you mean a mechanic did it
have + object + bare verb (have my car repair)
Mixing with make someone do (different structure)

cards.title: Quick check
cards.body: Who does the action — you, or someone you arrange?
points: Someone else / a service → have/get + object + past participle
Past participle after the object, always
